verdict.rationale: Twilio documents official native SDKs for JavaScript (Web), iOS, and Android, plus open-source reference apps on all three platforms. A shared server-side Rooms REST API, with participants and tracks, implies one backend serves every client. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the session/track object model is identical across the SDKs, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform interoperability.

support.subject: As a developer, official client SDKs cover web, iOS, and Android with the same session and track model, so one backend serves every platform

citations.quote: Twilio Video offers native SDKs for JavaScript (Web), iOS (Swift/Objective-C), and Android (Java/Kotlin).
